jobs.description: At Uni Systems, we are working towards turning digital visions into reality. We are continuously growing and we are looking for a professional AI & NLP Engineer to join our UniQue Petten, Netherlands team. What will you be bringing to the team? Collect and clean data from various sources. Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs. Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights. Recommend improvements based on data insights. Present data-driven insights and create actionable, decision-oriented recommendations tailored for non-technical audiences and stakeholders. Requirements What do you need to succeed in this position? Master Degree + minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience Knowledge and expertise on identification, collection, analysis, consolidation and modelling of data relevant to the materials demand and supply chain analysis for strategic technologies; Experience with data visualization and data mapping tools such as Tableau and ArcGIS; Ability to synthesize the result of large dataset analysis into communication and dissemination products such as reports, briefs and/or factsheets. Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights. Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements. Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively. Flexibility to adopt new data platforms, tools, and approaches. Ability to understand, speak and write English. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Job Summary:    AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. In this role, you will analyze data across our partner ecosystem—including sales performance, customer usage, licensing, and marketing—to provide insights into how our partners drive revenue growth, customer adoption, and long-term retention. Your work will help leadership make decisions on where to invest, which partners to prioritize, and how to grow our channel business effectively.   Key Responsibilities:   Partner Performance Analysis   Analyze how partners contribute to revenue growth, pipeline creation, and customer expansion across regions, channels, and segments.   Partner Health & Engagement Insights   Develop lifecycle metrics and scorecards to assess partner effectiveness based on engagement, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and training participation.   Revenue & Forecasting Support   Support reporting on recurring revenue (ARR), renewals, and pipeline, helping leadership understand growth trends and risks within the partner ecosystem.   Customer & Partner Relationship Insights   Analyze how customers move between direct sales and partners, and identify opportunities for expansion and retention through partner channels.   Partner Marketing Analytics   Measure the impact of partner-driven campaigns and initiatives on new partner acquisition and existing partner growth.   Predictive & Strategic Analysis   Build models to identify high-growth partners, at-risk partners, and opportunities to improve partner coverage or investment.   Dashboarding & Executive Reporting   Create clear, executive-ready dashboards and insights that help sales, marketing, and partner teams take action.   Cross-Functional Collaboration   Partner with Sales/Go-To-Market,

jobs.title: Staff or Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Identity & Audience
jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role Data isn't a support function at Vibe, it's the fuel. Every decision about which ad reaches which household, and when, runs on it. You'll join the Data Platform team and specialize in identity, turning billions of raw events into coherent, usable entities that power targeting, measurement, and the training sets Vibe's models learn from. You'll report to the Head of Data Platform. This role exists because identity resolution at Vibe's scale is a hard, unsolved problem, and the team needs someone who can build models that catch the right signal across petabytes of events. jobs.title: Applied ML Engineer/Data Scientist
jobs.description: 🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care. We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter. Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer. This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features
